name: Estée Lauder

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Estée Lauder Companies Logo.svg)

description: Estée Lauder makes and sells prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care under about two dozen brands, mostly through department stores, perfumeries, its own stores and websites, and travel retail (airport and duty-free shops). It earns money by selling products to retailers and consumers; skin care is nearly half of sales and almost all of the profit in fiscal 2026, because makeup, hair care and (until this year) fragrance barely broke even or lost money after charges. The Lauder family controls about 82 percent of the votes through Class B shares. Fiscal 2026 net sales were $15.0B (+5 percent), but operating income of $780M was cut by $823M of restructuring-related charges under a multi-year Profit Recovery and Growth Plan.
